name: dsh-cae-agent
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Cordis plugin that operates a live Abaqus/CAE session through its local socket bridge. Native abaqus_* tools (Tier-1 read / Tier-2 controlled write / Tier-3 run_python fallback). Written in TypeScript per the dsh-plugin-dev standard.

scripts.prepack: npm run link-deps && npm run build
scripts.test: node test/smoke.test.mjs && node test/codegen.test.mjs && node test/load.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
